question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline from the 1940s until the mid-1970s, list the purchases, mergers or consolidations involving the newspaper or its owning company, whether it was the buyer, the company bought or a party to a merger, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Ba lần mua hoặc sáp nhập khác nhau trong cùng một giai đoạn; đáp án là cả tập.
criterion: A purchase, merger or consolidation involving the paper or its owning company and another newspaper or company (the paper or its owner may be the buyer, the company bought or a merging party).

gold_events.text: Mercury Herald Company purchased the San Jose News; combined Sunday edition named Mercury Herald News.
Herman Ridder's Northwest Publications purchased the Mercury and News.
Ridder merged with Knight Newspapers to form Knight Ridder.

label: award
question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the awards that the newspaper itself, rather than its website, won, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Ba giải khác nhau của chính tờ báo; các giải của website (năm mốc trùng văn bản) bị loại vì không phân biệt được bằng lời.
criterion: An award won by the newspaper as an organisation, not by its website.

gold_events.text: Pulitzer Prize for reporting on Marcos administration corruption.
Pulitzer Prize for coverage of the 1989 Loma Prieta earthquake.
Won a Missouri Lifestyle Journalism Award for General Excellence.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline, list the occasions when the newsroom, the web staff or the printing operations moved to a different building or facility, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn lần chuyển cơ sở ở bốn thời điểm khác nhau.
criterion: A move of the newsroom, web staff, or printing operations into a different building or facility; bureau openings and closings are not included.

gold_events.text: Papers moved from downtown grocery store to North San Jose campus.
Web staff moved from the suburban campus to downtown San Jose.
Printing and production moved to Bay Area News Group Concord and Hayward facilities.
Mercury News moved into a downtown office building, leaving the North San Jose campus.

question: Among the dated events recorded in the timeline before the 2000s in which the newspaper's name was changed, a new name was adopted, or part of its name was dropped, which one came first?
why_needs_multiple: Chuỗi đổi tên có nhiều mốc; câu hỏi nhắm vào mốc đầu của chuỗi.
criterion: An event in which the newspaper's name was changed, a new name was adopted, or part of its name was dropped.

gold_events.text: Paper renamed the Santa Clara Register.
Merged paper became the Telegraph and Mercury.

question: Among the dated events in the timeline in which the newsroom, the web staff or the printing operations moved to a different building or facility, which was the earliest and which was the latest?
why_needs_multiple: Hai đầu của chuỗi chuyển cơ sở; cần đủ bốn mốc để biết đâu là đầu và cuối.
criterion: A move of the newsroom, web staff, or printing operations into a different building or facility; bureau openings and closings are not included.

gold_events.text: Papers moved from downtown grocery store to North San Jose campus.
Mercury News moved into a downtown office building, leaving the North San Jose campus.

question: Among the dated events from the 1940s until the mid-1970s in which the paper or its owning company acquired or combined with another newspaper or company, which one came immediately after the purchase of the Mercury and News by Northwest Publications?
why_needs_multiple: Mốc neo là một lần mua; đáp án là lần sáp nhập kế tiếp trong chuỗi.
criterion: A purchase, merger or consolidation in which the paper or its owning company acquired or combined with another newspaper or company.

gold_events.text: Herman Ridder's Northwest Publications purchased the Mercury and News.
Ridder merged with Knight Newspapers to form Knight Ridder.

question: How many years, counted by calendar year, passed between the Mercury News opening its foreign bureau in Hanoi and its closing that bureau?
why_needs_multiple: Khoảng cách giữa hai mốc được nêu tên, cần cả hai mốc để tính.
criterion: Opening and closing of the Hanoi foreign bureau.

gold_events.text: Opened Hanoi foreign bureau, first of two American dailies to do so.
Mercury News closed its Hanoi bureau.

question: How many years passed between the paper being renamed the Santa Clara Register and its becoming the Mercury News?
why_needs_multiple: Khoảng cách giữa hai lần đổi tên được nêu tên.
criterion: Renaming to the Santa Clara Register and the adoption of the Mercury News name.

gold_events.text: Paper renamed the Santa Clara Register.
Paper became the Mercury News after a series of mergers.
